unsupported.PreToolUse: Antigravity's PreToolUse allow would auto-approve the tool call and override native permissions, so it is never registered.
unsupported.compaction: Antigravity has no compaction events; a session saves its capsule with jevris_checkpoint and gets it back through the jevris_handoff_export tool.
unsupported.hooks.route: No Antigravity hook can change a subagent's model.
unsupported.statusLine: Antigravity has no plugin status line; run jevris status.
unsupported.subagents: Jevris makes no permission decision in a subagent, so Antigravity's own permissions govern it, and the verification gate holds only the parent's Stop, never SubagentStop: Antigravity has no SubagentStop hook, and it does not document whether its hooks run inside a subagent.
unsupported.access.session: No Antigravity hook is known to carry a failed turn's error, and Antigravity has no custom endpoint for a stub case, so access limits are read from owned runs only, as text, until a capture certifies them.

compatibility.basis: Not yet checked against the Antigravity CLI release notes. Same-minor is the default, and a new minor is re-checked in the background. A patch that changes the hook protocol shows up as a malformed live event, which demotes that feature and re-checks it.
